scope: Actual ordinary managed observer membership and partition assignment changes in the captured manual bridge group, preserving A2A durable state; not managed bridge ownership transfer, multiple hub writers or HA.
expected: Coordinator state Empty0→Stable1→Stable2→Stable1→Empty0 observed by actual Kafka CLI.
Single partition owner removed; prior idle observer receives partition0.
Observers auto-commit false and never send offset commit requests.
Manual bridge commits may be fenced by active managed membership; capture actual errors and broker-position lag without treating them as successful commits.
Backend durable position controls bridge recovery; accepted publications/delivery IDs/source and MID retries/independent acks survive one actual hub kill.
After all managed observers leave, a new accepted event leads to actual broker and durable next-offset convergence.
failure_policy: Retain failed run and actual broker replies; no source/fixture weakening or rerun until the specific cause is reported.
runtime: Exact34 native, pinned Confluent8.3.2 private18087; image qualification separately pending.
